question: Why do electric field lines start from positive charges and end on negative charges? Give reason.

options.A: Electric field direction is defined by the force on a positive test charge; it is away from positive charges and towards negative charges
options.B: Field lines start from negative charges because electrons move away from them
options.C: Field lines start and end on positive charges because positive test charges are repelled by all charges
options.D: Field lines have no relation to the direction of force on a test charge
